verdict.rationale: Box supports natural-language interaction with content: Box AI answers questions about files, summarizes them, and extracts metadata. The hosted MCP server and Box CLI let external AI agents search and use Box files over OAuth, so agents can be driven by natural-language prompts. The evidence only shows content Q&A, extraction and file search/use, not a first-party way to run general product actions by command. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control of product operations (sharing, collaborations, admin, workflows), a native in-product command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
